objective:
Add the ADMIN user-management feature to services/agents-ui, using the existing shared auth-api client at `@/lib/authApi` (import { authApi } or createAuthApiClient). CLIENT-only; do NOT touch backend, .github/workflows/ci.yml, or src/router/** (add only src/features/admin/routes.ts via the spec-022 FeatureRouteModule convention). Follow the existing feature pattern already in the repo (inspect src/features/account — merged — and src/features/projects/repositories for conventions): src/features/admin/{views,components,services,stores,routes.ts,types}, PrimeVue + Tailwind UI, Pinia store, Zod validation, vitest tests, vue-web-commons Toast/messages. Match antfu lint rules (all `import type` before value imports; external before relative within a group; case-insensitive named import/export sort; function-property method signatures in interfaces; `new TypeError` for type-guard throws; `} catch {`/`} else {` one-line; `;` member delimiters; lowercase describe titles; NO '/api/v1' literals or window.location host discovery in feature code — the auth-api client owns those). Reuse `// eslint-disable-line ts/consistent-type-assertions` only where a cast is genuinely needed.

Auth-api admin endpoints (all under the auth origin, paths relative to the client base which already appends /api/v1):
  - GET /admin/users -> AdminUserResponse[]
  - GET /admin/users/{id} -> AdminUserResponse
  - PATCH /admin/users/{id}/role  body UpdateRoleRequest { role: string } -> AdminUserResponse
  - PUT /admin/users/{id}/services  body UpdateServicePermissionsRequest { services: string[] } -> AdminUserResponse
  - DELETE /admin/users/{id} -> 204
AdminUserResponse = { id: string; username: string; email: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; role: 'ADMIN'|'USER'|'READONLY'|string; emailConfirmed: boolean; totpEnabled: boolean; servicePermissions: string[]; createdAt: string }.

Implement:
1) types/index.ts: TS types + Zod schemas for AdminUserResponse, UpdateRoleRequest, UpdateServicePermissionsRequest; an exported list of assignable roles ['ADMIN','USER','READONLY'].
2) services/adminService.ts: listUsers(), getUser(id), updateRole(id, role), updateServicePermissions(id, services), deleteUser(id) using the auth-api client. Encode path ids with encodeURIComponent.
3) stores/admin.ts: Pinia store holding users[], loading, error, selectedUser; actions wrapping the service and updating the cached list on mutate/delete.
4) views/AdminUsersView.vue: a PrimeVue DataTable (or the repo's established table pattern) listing users (username, email, role, emailConfirmed, totpEnabled, servicePermissions, createdAt). Per-row: a role <Select/Dropdown> to change role (calls updateRole with confirm), an editable services multiselect/chips to update service permissions (calls updateServicePermissions), and a Delete action behind a ConfirmDialog. Surface AuthApiError messages via Toast. Show loading + empty + error states. Optionally a detail panel/dialog using getUser.
5) routes.ts: default FeatureRouteModule { feature: 'admin', routes: [{ path: '/admin/users', name: 'admin-users', component: () => import('./views/AdminUsersView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: true, adminCapability: 'admin' } }], navigation: [{ id: 'admin-users', label: 'Users', to: { name: 'admin-users' }, section: 'admin', order: 10, icon: 'users', requiresAuth: true, adminCapability: 'admin' }] }.  ('admin' is the only valid AdminCapability per src/router/types.ts.)
6) Tests (vitest): adminService maps each endpoint (mocked auth-api client); store actions update state on list/role/services/delete success + error; AdminUsersView renders rows and triggers role change / services update / delete (mounted with mocked service/store, assert service calls + confirm flow). Use lowercase describe titles.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `build`. Do not add heavy new deps; reuse PrimeVue components already used in the repo. Ensure the auth-api client singleton is imported (already declared after its class — safe).
